summary: Held Session.logout is reachable in the mounted fixture runtime. Successful completion after navigation to /public-profile/demo-jordan logs out as expected and leaves the route unchanged, but unconditionally clears the foreign profile projection: Demo Jordan becomes a generic fallback profile and edit reports profile_unavailable. Injected logout failure preserves the foreign projection and edit rejects profile_owner_mismatch. On captured Sarah reference, the controller projection is cleared and edit reports profile_unavailable, while the public-site renderer independently continues displaying the captured read-only content; no edit authority is gained. Ordinary same-route logout succeeds, clears the own projection and navigates to /login.

cases.foreign_success_race: success; anonymous; /public-profile/demo-jordan retained; Demo Jordan projection lost; generic fallback rendered; edit denied profile_unavailable
cases.foreign_failure_control: denied; authenticated session unchanged; /public-profile/demo-jordan retained with Demo Jordan; edit denied profile_owner_mismatch
cases.captured_readonly_success_race: success; anonymous; route retained; captured-readonly controller projection lost; Sarah still visibly rendered by special captured-reference renderer; edit denied profile_unavailable
